implemented: Single corpse pickup, take-all and lottery delivery share the successful transfer/acquisition hook. GETITEM objectives refresh from the resulting inventory, and TT_GETITEM fires for the actual recipient, after capacity/ownership checks. Native local/lottery target IDs and pre-transfer item/count snapshots are retained.

Take-all skips items already being drawn for and starts the existing party lottery for eligible items. It cannot immediately grant those items or their quest progress. Party pickup notices use the existing path.
Corpse money/items and lottery participants/winners must be on a current main in-game session. A leaving winner retains the item on the corpse rather than changing inventory or quest state.
Destroying a quest item refreshes its fetch objective via PlayerCheckQuest, matching the native move/drop hook. It does not fire an acquisition event; normal slot moves are unchanged.

The server expires running main-session quest timers on its tick, even without CS_QUESTENDTIMER_REQ. Early notifications cannot disable a deadline; repeated notifications do not duplicate failure updates. Strict greater-than expiry remains unchanged.

An explicit failed-timer state prevents an expiry notification from making the quest completable. Drop/reacceptance resets the timer state. Zero remaining time reloads already failed, including at map tick zero.

Every running timer is included in save snapshots even after the dirty flag clears. Shared remaining-time calculation handles unsigned clock wrap; login packets carry current remaining time instead of reissuing the original duration.
